_about: Model prices in US dollars per million tokens, used when the provider does not report a cost. The key is the model ID exactly as set in SUPERVISOR_MODEL, SPECIALIST_MODEL or ROUTER_MODEL. A model that is not listed has its calls counted as unpriced rather than as free. Prices are entered by hand: confirm them against your provider's price list and update them when it changes. Point MODEL_PRICES_FILE at another file to keep your prices out of the repository.
